title: 第16章 这就是个祸害，必须退兵！
novel_title: 都重生了谁还复读？去当兵吧(酸辣榔头)
content_zh: “这个，先前连长呢，主要提到的训练和生活方面。”“讲的很详细，我就不再过多赘述，我就简单补充强调一点。”“纪律，尤其是新兵思想方面的纪律，主要分为三个大项……”连部会议室，指导员何镇涛正在强调新兵思想纪律的重要性。着重强调军人规章制度，条令条例，以及保密守则。底下一众班排长拿着笔，认真的做好会议记录。散会后，得通过班务会的形式传递会议精神，规范新兵们的行为思想。训练开展已经十来天，依旧有不少新兵到目前为止，都没能完全适应现在身份。虽然穿上军装人在军营，但内在相当轻浮，心还在外头的花花世界飘着，所以规范行为思想非常有必要。也能加速催化他们从社会青年，完成向一个合格战士的转变。正当指导员着重强调，军人保密意识的重要性时，外头的门忽然被人敲响。负责楼道值班的四班长探头进来，喊了声报告，随即从冲着周凯东说道。“一排长，出来一下，你们班出了点状况。”“去吧。”周凯东心里咯噔一下，征询的看向指导员，得到准许后赶紧离开座位。刚出来，就瞧见走廊上站着的陆阳，他眉头当即皱紧。“怎么了，出什么事了？”“班长，丁腾飞他，犯了点错误……”陆阳将情况快速作出汇报，并将他的那部摩托罗拉手机递给周凯东。接过手机时，他手心微微出汗，他真的很希望陆阳在跟他开玩笑？周凯东深呼吸好几口气，做足思想准备，尽可能让内心保持镇定。当看到聊天记录里的内容，还有配文“单身可撩”的军装自拍，差点两眼一黑气背过去。“人...在哪儿？”“我让孔垄给他控制住了。”“草……他...么！！！”周凯东整个人无比抓狂，一拳就打在墙砖上。他没想到只是开个晨会的工夫，丁腾飞就给他捅了这么大个篓子。刚指导员还在会上着重强调思想纪律，严防死守泄密问题，他立马就撞枪口上了。这已经不是在给连长指导员上眼药，这是硬生生往他们眼睛里涂辣椒水！周凯东本想带着陆阳先回去处理问题，等会议结束了再来做汇报。结果何镇涛直接推门走了出来，询问他们怎么回事？周凯东无奈，只能将手机交上去，并如实阐述事情经过。何镇涛当即就觉得心跳漏了一拍，尤其是看到丁腾飞那条骚里骚气的自拍，以及底下荤段子满天飞的各种评论，下眼睑更是疯狂抽动。意识到问题的严重性，他立即推门强行中断了会议，将连长也给喊了出来。得知事情经过，连长捂着腰子，感觉昏天黑地：“我，我特么肝儿都气疼了！”……三班宿舍里，丁腾飞被一帮人堵在宿舍里不让出去。他已经冷静下来，不再像之前那样闹腾，反倒是有些服软的意思。“至于嘛，我不就是拍了几张照片，多大点事？”“陆阳神经兮兮，你们也神经兮兮，用不用这么小题大做？”“你给我松开，大不了一会班长来了，我主动承认错误还不行吗？”外头，一阵密集的脚步声响起，被陆阳招来的可不仅仅是班长周凯东。连长和指导员，还有其他几个排长全都阴沉着脸出现在门口。丁腾飞刚站起来身，就结结实实的挨了一个雷欧飞踢。“王八蛋，知不知道自已在干什么？”“班长，我不是故意的……”被一脚踹翻的丁腾飞似乎也意识到了问题严重性，语气都变怂了许多。都说好汉不吃眼前亏，等过了这一关，又是一条好汉。周凯东狠狠臭骂他几句，然后回过头向连长求情：“连长，这件事错主要在我，是我管教不严……”高峰冷冷的摆摆手：“错的不是你，是我，我就不该来当你们连长！”他把周凯东推到一边，走过去给丁腾飞提起来：“军人保密守则，看没看过？知不知道和部队有关的东西，都是涉密的！”“你偷拍营区建筑是什么意思，拍你们班训练成绩表是什么意思？”“三公里测验跑了班排倒数，你还好意思在网上嘚瑟炫耀？”“这些东西如果被有心之人截取，盗用，分析，会产生多大的恶劣影响，你知不知道？”高峰最后这句，几乎是从肺里直接吼出来的。他是真的快气炸了，这小子犯的错误不仅牵累周凯东，他这个连长也得跟着一块倒血霉！第三年了，他提副营一直没能提上去，这下就更没机会了！整不好，现在这上尉连长，就是他未来军旅生涯的尽头！丁腾飞也懵了，也没想到自已无意间的举动，会捅这么大篓子。他求助的看向陆阳，看向周凯东，但根本就没用。泄密带来的恶劣影响，别说是连长，就是营长来了都兜不住。这一刻，丁腾飞才意识到先前陆阳抢夺手机时说的话，并不是吓唬自已……“连长，我，我知道错了，我现在就把说说删掉还不行吗？”“我就发给几个朋友看看，他们不会往外传的……”高峰都快被这小子给气笑了，见过蠢的，没见过这么蠢的。如果这件事这么容易解决，他们就不会发这么大火，生这么大气。这时，始终没开口的指导员何镇涛叹了口气，也终于开了口。“说说，我们已经删了，但发出去的照片，已经撤不回来了。”“事已至此说再多也没用，这件事我们只能层层上报，至于上头会怎么处理，谁也不清楚。”“但在此之前，只能请你先到禁闭室好好反省；还有条令条例，军人保密守则，各罚抄两百遍……”宣布完暂时处理结果，丁腾飞就被带去关禁闭了。连长和指导员也把周凯东带走，商量着后续该怎么弄。其他班排长临走前，也是摇头叹息，嘴里说着“害人害已啊”之类的话。显然这样的事情一出，不光是周凯东这个班排长受影响，整个新兵连往后很长一段时间，可能都会不得安宁。甚至会迎来非常可怕的作风纪律整顿，这是连他们这些老兵都极不愿意经历的。作风纪律整顿期间，周末，放松，手机，午休，甚至会餐统统取消。几乎就是把兵往死里练，榨干所有人的最后精力，折腾到每个人精疲力竭.......等人离开，三班新兵立马朝着陆阳围拢过来，紧张兮兮的讨论起来。“班副，难怪先前看你那么激动，原来部队泄密后果这么严重嘛？”“丁腾飞他到底拍了些啥，先前在宿舍里，也没见他拍啊？”“估计是背着咱偷偷拍的，你们说，这小子会不会是间谍啊？”“间谍？他有那脑子？纯纯一山炮！”孔垄咂咂嘴：“该说不说，咱班长还挺仗义，刚才那一脚看似踹的重，实际擦这边儿过去的，转头就把错往自已身上揽。”“咱班长一直都是这么个外冷内热的人，都是一个班的肯定得护着。”陆阳无奈的说：“都别议论了，接下来咱做好自已的事，别再给班长添堵了。”大家忽然觉得不论是班副，还是班长，人都真挺不错。班长平时凶巴巴的，一切从严要求，但也是为他们好。班副在关键时刻及时出手，制止了事态继续恶化，也是尽职尽责。反倒是陆阳觉得，他其实可以做的更好一些，至少这样事情就不会闹得这么大了。.......“呵呵，你担着？”“你特么拿什么担？”“拿你这身军装，还是拿你以后的前途？”“周凯东，你三期了，你知不知道三期意味着什么？”连长办公室里，高峰叼着烟，找了两个火机都没能点着。气得他一巴掌把火机拍在桌上，抬手想要给周凯东点教训，但都下不去手。虽然这个兵不是他一手带出来的，但也是团里出了名能吃苦的好兵，拿过优秀立过功！高峰把没点着的烟一把丢桌上，恨铁不成钢的说：“当初点验，我就看出这个兵有大问题，寻思你是个十年老兵了应该能应付！”“结果大周末的，给我闹个这么大的惊喜回来。还，还说什么你担着，你是扁担呐！”“真是他娘的犟种！别说是你，就是你们六连长来了，这事也够喝一壶的！”平日里，在三班新兵面前威风凛凛的周凯东被骂的抬不起头。就这么任由连长的唾沫星子飞溅在脸上，却依旧想尽办法把责任往身上揽。新兵犯错误，就是班长没教好，手机也是他让陆阳发下去的，他就必须是第一责任人。何镇涛劝说连长冷静点，别激动：“现在当务之急，是讨论怎么去处理和补救，不是在这争谁的责任。”高峰像是炸毛了一样，调门都高了八度：“补救，怎么补救？那小子他娘的不是发了一张两张，是特么发了一堆照片！”“还特么单身可撩，我现在恨不得把他吊在单杠上，拿枪给他突突了，简直丢光了我们军人的脸！”“要是放在打仗那会儿，他这行为跟投敌有什么区别？几张照片就能暴露营区位置，把所有人都给害死！”“退兵，必须退兵！这样的祸害留在部队，就是他奶奶的遗祸千年！”
content_en: "This, the company commander mentioned earlier mainly focused on training and life." "It was very detailed. I won't go into details. I will simply add and emphasize one point." "Discipline, especially the ideological discipline of recruits, is mainly divided into three major items..." In the company headquarters conference room, instructor He Zhentao was emphasizing the importance of recruits' ideological discipline.Emphasis is placed on military rules, regulations, and confidentiality.The platoon leaders below took pens and carefully took minutes of the meeting.After the meeting, the spirit of the meeting must be conveyed through a squad meeting and the behavior and thoughts of the recruits should be regulated.The training has been carried out for more than ten days, and there are still many recruits who have not been able to fully adapt to their current status.Although people in military uniforms are in the military camp, they are quite frivolous on the inside, and their hearts are still wandering in the colorful world outside, so it is very necessary to regulate their behavior and thoughts.It can also accelerate and catalyze their transformation from social youth to a qualified warrior.Just as the instructor emphasized the importance of military confidentiality, there was a sudden knock on the door outside.The fourth squad leader in charge of the corridor duty came in, shouted a report, and then said to Zhou Kaidong."First Platoon Commander, come out, something happened in your class." "Go." Zhou Kaidong's heart skipped a beat, and he looked at the instructor inquiringly, and quickly left his seat after receiving permission.As soon as he came out, he saw Lu Yang standing in the corridor, and he frowned immediately."What's wrong? What happened?" "Squad leader, Ding Tengfei, he made some mistakes..." Lu Yang quickly reported the situation and handed his Motorola mobile phone to Zhou Kaidong.When he took the phone, his palms were slightly sweaty. He really hoped that Lu Yang was joking with him?Zhou Kaidong took several deep breaths, prepared himself mentally, and tried to keep his heart as calm as possible.When I saw the content in the chat history, as well as the selfie in military uniform with the caption "You can flirt when you're single," I almost turned my head in anger."Where...is he?" "I asked Kong Long to control him." "Fuck...he...!!!" Zhou Kaidong was so crazy that he punched the wall brick.He didn't expect that Ding Tengfei would poke such a big hole in him during just a morning meeting.Just when the instructor emphasized ideological discipline at the meeting and strictly guarded against leaking secrets, he immediately got into trouble.This is no longer giving eye drops to the company commander and instructor, this is forcibly applying pepper water into their eyes!Zhou Kaidong originally wanted to take Lu Yang back to deal with the problem first, and then make a report after the meeting was over.As a result, He Zhentao opened the door and walked out, asking them what happened?Zhou Kaidong had no choice but to hand over his mobile phone and truthfully explain what happened.He Zhentao immediately felt that his heartbeat had skipped a beat, especially when he saw Ding Tengfei's sultry selfie and the various comments with dirty jokes underneath, his lower eyelids twitched crazily.Realizing the seriousness of the problem, he immediately opened the door and forcibly interrupted the meeting, calling out the company commander.After learning what happened, the company commander clutched his waist and felt dizzy: "I, my liver is so angry that it hurts!"... In the third class dormitory, Ding Tengfei was blocked in the dormitory by a group of people and was not allowed to leave.He has calmed down and is no longer as noisy as before. On the contrary, he is somewhat submissive."As for that, I just took a few photos, what's the big deal?" "Lu Yang is nervous, and you are also nervous, why do you need to make such a fuss?" "Let me go, the squad leader will come in a while, why don't I take the initiative to admit my mistakes?" Outside, there was a burst of footsteps, and it was not just squad leader Zhou Kaidong who was summoned by Lu Yang.The company commander, instructor, and several other platoon commanders all appeared at the door with gloomy faces.As soon as Ding Tengfei stood up, he received a solid kick from Leo."You bastard, do you know what you are doing?" "Squad leader, I didn't mean to do it..." Ding Tengfei, who was kicked over, seemed to realize the seriousness of the problem, and his tone became much more timid.It is said that a good man never suffers immediate losses. Once he has passed this level, he will be a good man again.Zhou Kaidong scolded him a few times, and then turned around to plead with the company commander: "Company commander, the main fault in this matter is my fault. It's my lax discipline..." Gao Feng waved his hand coldly: "It's not you that's at fault, it's me. I shouldn't be your company commander!" He pushed Zhou Kaidong aside and walked over to mention it to Ding Tengfei: "Have you read the Military Secrecy Code? Do you know anything related to the army?It's all confidential!" "What do you mean by secretly photographing the camp building and taking pictures of your class's training results?" "How dare you show off on the Internet when you finish last in the three-kilometer test?" "Do you know how bad these things will be if they are intercepted, stolen, and analyzed by someone with intentions?" Gao Feng shouted the last sentence from his lungs.He was really furious. The mistake this kid made not only affected Zhou Kaidong, but also his company commander had to suffer the same fate!In the third year, he has never been promoted to deputy battalion, and now he has no chance!If things go wrong, this captain and company commander will be the end of his military career in the future!Ding Tengfei was also stunned, and he didn't expect that his unintentional actions would cause such a big mistake.He looked at Lu Yang and Zhou Kaidong for help, but it was no use.Not to mention the company commander, even the battalion commander would not be able to cope with the negative impact of leaking secrets.At this moment, Ding Tengfei realized that what Lu Yang said when he snatched the phone was not to scare him... "Company Commander, I, I know I was wrong. Can't I just delete it now?" "I'll just send it to a few friends to see, they won't spread it..." Gao Feng almost laughed out of anger at this kid. He has seen stupid people, but never such stupid people.If this matter was so easy to solve, they wouldn't be so angry and angry.At this time, the instructor He Zhentao, who had never spoken, sighed and finally spoke."Tell me, we have deleted it, but the photos we sent out can no longer be withdrawn." "It is useless to say more about what has happened now. We can only report this matter step by step. As for how the superiors will deal with it, no one knows." "But before that, I can only ask you to go to the solitary room to reflect on it; there are also regulations, military confidentiality rules, and you are punished to copy them two hundred times..." After announcing the temporary results, Ding Tengfei was taken to solitary confinement.The company commander and instructor also took Zhou Kaidong away to discuss what to do next.Before the other platoon leaders left, they also shook their heads and sighed, saying things like "You are harming others and harming yourself."Obviously, once something like this happens, not only Zhou Kaidong, the squad leader, will be affected, but the entire recruit company may not be in peace for a long time.There will even be a very terrible disciplinary rectification of style, which even veterans like them are extremely unwilling to experience.During the period of style discipline rectification, weekends, relaxation, mobile phones, lunch breaks, and even dinner parties are all cancelled.It was almost like training the soldiers to death, squeezing out the last energy from everyone, and tossing them until everyone was exhausted... When the others left, the third class of recruits immediately gathered around Lu Yang and started discussing nervously."Squad deputy, no wonder I saw you so excited earlier. Are the consequences of leaking secrets from the army so serious?" "What did Ding Tengfei take? I didn't see him taking any pictures in the dormitory before?" "I guess he took the pictures secretly behind my back. Do you think this guy is a spy?" "Spy? What kind of brains does he have? Pure and simple!" Kong Long smacked his lips: "Should I say it or not, our squad leader is quite loyal. Just nowThe kick seemed to be hard, but it actually hit him. He turned around and took the blame on himself."Our squad leader has always been such a cold-blooded person, and everyone in the class must be protected."Lu Yang said helplessly, "Don't talk about it. Let's do our own thing and stop causing trouble for the squad leader."Everyone suddenly felt that both the squad deputy and the squad leader were really good people.The squad leader is usually fierce and strict in everything, but it is also for their own good.The squad deputy took action in time at the critical moment to prevent the situation from deteriorating, and he also performed his duties.On the contrary, Lu Yang felt that he could actually do better, at least this way the matter would not be such a big deal...... "Haha, you are carrying it?" "What the hell are you carrying?" "For your military uniform, or for your future future?" "Zhou Kaidong, you are in the third term, do you know what the third term means?" In the company commander's office, Gao Feng was holding a cigarette in his mouth and couldn't light it after finding two lighters.He was so angry that he slapped the lighter on the table and raised his hand to teach Zhou Kaidong a lesson, but he couldn't do it.Although he did not lead this soldier by himself, he is also known as a good soldier in the regiment who can endure hardships and has won outstanding achievements and made meritorious service!Gao Feng threw the unlit cigarette on the table and said angrily: "When I checked, I could tell there was a big problem with this soldier. I thought you were a ten-year veteran and you should be able to handle it!" "It turned out that it was a big weekend and you came back with such a big surprise for me.What's more, you're carrying a shoulder pole!" "You're such a bastard!Even if it's you, even your sixth company commander is here, this is enough for you!" On weekdays, Zhou Kaidong, who is so majestic in front of the recruits of the third class, can't hold his head up after being scolded.Just letting the company commander's saliva splash on his face, he still tried his best to take the responsibility on himself.When a recruit makes a mistake, it's because the squad leader didn't teach him well, and he asked Lu Yang to hand out the cell phone, so he must be the first responsible person.He Zhentao persuaded the company commander to calm down and not get excited: "The top priority now is to discuss how to deal with and remedy the situation, not to argue about whose responsibility it is." Gao Feng seemed to be furious, and his tone was raised an octave: "Remedy, how to remedy it? That kid sent not one or two fucking photos, but a bunch of photos!" "You are so single and flirtatious, I am nowI want to hang him on the horizontal bar and shoot him with a gun.It is a disgrace to our soldiers!" "If it were during the war, what would be the difference between his behavior and surrendering to the enemy?A few photos can expose the location of the camp and kill everyone!" "Retreat, you must retreat!This kind of harm will be left to the army for thousands of years!"
